title: Build AI3 Augmented Institutional Intelligence measurement system
summary: AI3 must launch as an institutional intelligence measurement system, not a survey-only readiness tool. It must include survey signals, operational telemetry, workflow observation, governance evidence, knowledge-system data, and worker/runtime traces from day one.
core_positioning: AI3 measures the ability of humans, AI systems, organisational structures, and worker/runtime systems to think, coordinate, adapt, recover, govern, and improve together.

minimum_real_standard.real: Survey plus telemetry plus governance receipts plus operational traces plus worker/runtime evidence

requested_worker_actions: Create Supabase-ready schema for AI3 measurement objects and events
Create CSV/question bank for human, AI, organisation, governance, telemetry and worker layers
Create scoring and maturity model with evidence weighting
Create dashboard/widget spec for AI3 Index, friction maps, worker health and governance maturity
Bind AI3 to portfolio worker model, including the 729-worker layer as measurable institutional execution fabric
Return GitHub receipt and evidence classification
